title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use DOXYCYCLINE CAPSULES safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for DOXYCYCLINE CAPSULES. DOXYCYCLINE capsules, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 1967

sections.contraindications: This drug is contraindicated in persons who have shown hypersensitivity to doxycycline or any other tetracyclines.
sections.boxed_warning: 40 mg hard gelatin capsule with beige opaque body and beige opaque cap, imprinted “APO D40” in black ink. Filled with mixture of white to off-white and pale yellow, round shape, biconvex tablets. Bottle of 30 (NDC 60505-4775-3) Bottle of 500 (NDC 60505-4775-5) Storage: All products are to be stored at controlled room temperatures of 59°F to 86°F (15°C to 30°C) and dispensed in tight, light-resistant containers (USP). Keep out of reach of children.
